title: Histological Staining of Fish Gonadal Tissue
author: Jhennifer Gomes Cordeiro
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ygvftw6
materials: Leave in eosin solution for 15 minutes 00:15:00

steps.title: Dissect and fix gonads
steps.instruction: Make a ventro‑longitudinal incision to expose the gonads, immediately apply Bouin's fixative onto the gonads, then remove the gonads and place them directly into Bouin's fixative.

steps.title: Fix overnight in Bouin's
steps.instruction: Leave the gonads in Bouin's fixative for 24 h (overnight).

steps.title: Replace fixative with ethanol
steps.instruction: After 24 h, discard Bouin's fixative and replace it with 70 % ethanol, renewing the ethanol daily until no trace of Bouin's remains.

steps.title: Section tissue for molds
steps.instruction: Before dehydration, cut the tissue into the desired shape so it fits into the embedding molds.

steps.title: Place samples in glass vials
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue pieces into glass vials that will receive the subsequent solutions.

steps.title: Ethanol series up to 95 %
steps.instruction: Perform three rapid changes of 70 %, 80 %, and 90 % ethanol, each for 3 min, then leave the samples in 95 % ethanol for 40 min.

steps.title: Infiltrate with 1:1 resin‑alcohol
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in a 1:1 mixture of 95 % ethanol and infiltration resin (methacrylate glycol) for 40 min.

steps.title: Overnight resin infiltration
steps.instruction: Leave the samples in infiltration resin (methacrylate glycol) for at least 12 h (overnight).

steps.title: Prepare inclusion resin
steps.instruction: Mix methacrylate glycol resin with hardener at a ratio of 0.07 mL hardener per 1.0 mL resin.

steps.title: Embed tissue in resin mold
steps.instruction: Place the tissue block into the mold and fill the mold with the resin + hardener mixture; allow polymerization to occur.

steps.title: Dry polymerized blocks
steps.instruction: After polymerization, place the embedded blocks in a drying stove for 24 h.

steps.title: Glue block to microtome support
steps.instruction: Unblock the polymerized block and glue it onto a microtome support stick using epoxy resin glue; allow the glue to dry completely.

steps.title: Section to 3‑5 µm
steps.instruction: Trim the block on the microtome and cut sections of 3 to 5 µm thickness; collect sections on properly identified glass slides.

steps.title: Dry slides before staining
steps.instruction: Place the slides in a drying stove for 1 day before proceeding to staining.

steps.title: H&E – hydrate sections
steps.instruction: Immerse the slides in running tap water for 10 min.

steps.title: H&E – hematoxylin stain
steps.instruction: Place the slides in Harri's hematoxylin solution for 15 min.

steps.title: H&E – wash
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in running tap water for 10 min.

steps.title: H&E – dehydrate
steps.instruction: Dehydrate quickly in 90 % ethanol for 3 min (fast change; used when eosin is alcoholic).

steps.title: H&E – rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides well under running water.

steps.title: H&E – clearing series
steps.instruction: Pass the slides through rapid changes of 70 %, 80 %, and 95 % ethanol, then absolute ethanol, followed by two 3‑min changes of xylene; finally transfer to a third change of xylene for 3 min.

steps.title: H&E – mount
steps.instruction: Mount the sections with Permount (xylene‑based mounting medium) and place a coverslip.

steps.title: Toluidine – hydrate sections
steps.instruction: Immerse the slides in running water for 10 min.

steps.title: Toluidine – dye
steps.instruction: Place the slides in toluidine blue solution for 15 min.

steps.title: Toluidine – wash
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in running water for 10 min.

steps.title: Toluidine – clearing series
steps.instruction: Pass the slides through rapid changes of 70 %, 80 %, and 95 % ethanol, then absolute ethanol, followed by two 3‑min changes of xylene; then a third change of xylene for 3 min.

steps.title: Toluidine – mount
steps.instruction: Mount the sections with Permount and place a coverslip.

steps.title: Examine and photograph slides
steps.instruction: Inspect the stained slides under a microscope and capture photographs as needed.
